Download public-use microdata

Source: R/surveys.R
knbs_download_microdata.Rd

No supported source currently permits this. The Kenya National Data Archive gates every download behind an account, and this package does not automate sign-in, licence acceptance or approval workflows, so the function reports what is required and stops.

Usage

knbs_download_microdata(
  survey,
  files = NULL,
  destination = ".",
  overwrite = FALSE,
  verify = TRUE,
  manifest = TRUE,
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

survey

A study identifier.

files

Files to download.

destination

Directory to write to.

overwrite

Whether to overwrite existing files.

verify

Whether to verify downloads.

manifest

Whether to write a download manifest.

quiet

Whether to suppress progress messages.

Value

Never returns; raises knbs_error_authentication_required.

Details

It exists so that the refusal is explicit and points at the official process, rather than the operation appearing to be unsupported by oversight.

See also

knbs_survey_files() to see what a study holds and on what terms.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Raises an error explaining the official access process:
knbs_download_microdata("KEN-KNBS-KIHBS-2015-2016-v01")
} # }
